description.value: Earnest Ice Cream is a values-driven Vancouver artisan ice cream company founded in 2012, operating four scoop shops with this Frances Street location also housing their East Van production kitchen. The company is known for rotating seasonal flavours made from local and organic ingredients, a robust sustainability program including carbon-neutral operations and a returnable glass-jar pint system, and donating 1% of revenue to community causes. Event catering and self-scoop tub pickups are available exclusively from this Frances Street shop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Earnest Ice Cream is an active multi-location artisan ice cream company; the Frances Street location is also their East Van production kitchen and the exclusive pickup point for event orders. OSM tags (takeaway=only, indoor_seating=no, outdoor_seating=no, diet:vegan=limited) are directly corroborated by website FAQ content confirming vegan flavours and no dine-in seating. Neither OSM tags nor website content mention bike parking, washrooms, or water refill, so those required criteria cannot be confirmed.
